observations: Architecture: As documented in AGENTS.md, docs/ai-context/ARCHITECTURE.md, and AUDIT_FIX_PROGRESS.md, the application is built on Java 17 and FlatLaf Swing, adhering strictly to a multi-tier structure: GUI -> BUS -> DAO -> Entity, supported by shared utilities in utils (e.g., src/utils/UserSession.java, src/utils/DBConnection.java). DAO and SQL logic are isolated from GUI components, with business coordination handled in BUS classes such as src/bus/DangNhapBus.java.

DB Verification Uncertainty: As recorded in docs/ai-context/STATUS.md, docs/ai-context/DECISIONS.md (Decision 7), and AUDIT_FIX_PROGRESS.md, compile success is maintained separately from database and UI testing ('Báo riêng kết quả compile, UI và CSDL. Không suy ra nghiệp vụ đúng từ compile thành công'). While Java 17 compilation succeeds across src/**/*.java, database connectivity remains unverified and offline (historical audit noted DB offline and DBConnection.main failure), and no automated DB migrations or live JDBC queries are executed during setup.

No-Git Policy: Per AGENTS.md, docs/ai-context/STATUS.md, and docs/ai-context/DECISIONS.md (Decision 6), all Git and GitHub operations are prohibited (no commits, branches, pushes, worktrees, or Git configuration modifications). Changes and verification are managed strictly through local backups and diffs.
output.summary: Identified project architecture (Java Swing GUI -> BUS -> DAO -> Entity), separation of compile/DB/UI verification with DB uncertainty, and strict no-Git policy from supplied context files.
